stock exchange noun

also stock market, stockbroker, stock broker, bourse

modern

Traupman 385

bursa, bursae f.

noun, first declension · Declension on Wiktionary

the stock exchange, the stock market

From the European name of the exchange (Börse, bourse); not in Lewis & Short.

Other words

  • chrēmatistērium, chrēmatistēriī n. — the stock market

    noun, second declension · also used · modern · Traupman 385 · Declension on Wiktionary

    Traupman’s coinage from Greek χρηματιστήριον, the Greek for a stock exchange.
